data.notes: November is anchored by Iceland Airwaves, with its showcase-festival core spilling into special electronic, hip-hop, pop and local-scene events before and after the main weekend.

events.title: Iceland Airwaves 2026
events.summary: Reykjavík’s flagship multi-venue showcase festival returns with an official program across downtown venues. Confirmed artists include 9m88, Agent Fresco, Cell7, Cobrah, David Bay, Emmsjé Gauti, Jamie Woon, MAMMÚT, Sísý Ey, Skeler, The Itch, Warhaus and many more.

events.title: The Streets with Úlfur Úlfur
events.summary: The Streets close the Airwaves run at Eldborg, Harpa, performing A Grand Don’t Come For Free in full with additional catalogue tracks. Icelandic rap duo Úlfur Úlfur open the night.

events.title: GusGus at Austurbæjarbíó
events.summary: Iceland Airwaves and GusGus present an electronic partner event from 22:00–03:00. The schedule lists DJ Margeir, a midnight GusGus live set and Exos live at 02:00.

events.title: Daði Freyr & The Iceland Symphony Orchestra
events.summary: Daði Freyr performs with the Iceland Symphony Orchestra for the first time in an Iceland Airwaves special event at Eldborg, Harpa. The program reimagines his synth-pop songs with orchestral arrangements and includes music from his upcoming album.

events.title: Shygirl with Alaska & Joey Christ
events.summary: Iceland Airwaves presents Shygirl for a separate-ticket IA26 special event, with local support from Alaska and Joey Christ. The show is billed as an experimental pop, club and hip-hop event on the night before the main festival opens.

events.title: Iceland Airwaves Conference 2026
events.summary: The Airwaves music-industry conference runs 09:00–18:00 across two days, with panels on live music, showcase festivals, sustainability, music curation and Iceland’s music export ecosystem. It is held in collaboration with Iceland Music, Reykjavík Music City and Business Iceland.

events.title: AFROFEST: Luis Lucas DJ Set
events.summary: A Reykjavík Dance Festival diaspora club/performance crossover: staged Afrobeats × Amapiano DJ set with live dance, centered on Nigerian, South African and wider African-diaspora club culture.

events.title: MYRKRAEYJA – Danspartý, performansar & DJ / SHADOWS
events.summary: Reykjavík Dance Festival closing dance party led by Kanema and Luis, foregrounding dance, performance and DJ culture with amapiano, afrobeat, pop and other cross-diaspora influences.

events.title: HAM - Endalok alls
events.summary: HAM celebrate the release of their album Endalok alls with a concert at Eldborg, Harpa. The set is announced to include new songs, older material and guest performers Úlfur Eldjárn, Steinunn Eldflaug Harðardóttir and Kristjana Stefánsdóttir.

events.title: TODMOBILE – HÁPUNKTAR
events.summary: Icelandic pop-rock band Todmobile play a career-spanning celebratory concert at Eldborg after receiving honorary recognition at the Icelandic Music Awards. The lineup features the band plus guests including Jónína Björt Gunnarsdóttir, Söngsveitin Filharmónía, Strokkvartettinn Siggi and Guðni Franzson.

events.title: Iceland’s Liberation Orchestra featuring Davíð Þór Jónsson - Múlinn Jazzclub
events.summary: Múlinn Jazzclub date built around a new Haukur Gröndal piano concerto for Davíð Þór Jónsson and ensemble, balancing composed material with free improvisation from leading Icelandic jazz players.

events.title: Upprásin | Spouses, Brenninetla, ÞESAL
events.summary: Harpa’s grassroots Icelandic music series Upprásin presents Spouses, Brenninetla and ÞESAL in Kaldalón. The series is run with Reykjavík Music City and Rás 2 to spotlight emerging Icelandic acts across genres.

events.title: Sigurður Flosason Quartet - Múlinn Jazzclub
events.summary: Veteran saxophonist Sigurður Flosason leads a quartet through modern jazz rooted in bebop, with Anna Gréta Sigurðardóttir, Birgir Steinn Theódórsson and Einar Scheving.

events.title: Andrés Þór Trio – Relocate - Múlinn Jazzclub
events.summary: Múlinn Jazzclub’s November opener at Björtuloft, Harpa, featuring Andrés Þór’s trio around the 2026 album Relocate with improvisation-led guitar-trio material.

events.title: Björn Thoroddsen Band - Múlinn Jazzclub
events.summary: Múlinn Jazzclub presents Icelandic guitarist Björn Thoroddsen with Jón Rafnsson on bass and Fúsi Óttars on drums. Harpa bills the night as jazz and blues, with Thoroddsen moving across pop, jazz, rock, blues and country influences.

events.title: PVBR & Poetic Funk present Winter Gathering 2026 Iceland
events.summary: A three-day funk, soul and groove weekender from Positive Vibrations Reykjavik and Poetic Funk, with all-day parties on November 20–21 and a recreation day on November 22; announced DJs include Atjazz, DJ Fraggle, Tommi and Ingvar, with sounds spanning funk, soul, boogie, jazz, Latin, afro beat, bruk beat and soulful/funky house.
